{{Top|leg}}
'''Ugorian Divine Law''' was the legal system of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] species.<ref name="EOTJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> All Ugors and all visitors to the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]] were expected to adhere to the tenets of Divine Law. This compliance was enforced by armed [[Black Hole-class Salvage Dreadnought|Ugor battle-wagons]]. Ugor [[Holy Officer]]s were the arbiters of the law.<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref> One of Ugorian Divine Law's precepts held that when an Ugor touched an unclaimed object, the slime of its pseudopod both made the object holy and marked it as the Ugor's property.<ref name="EOTJ" />
